# Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness

## Overview

Build a single-page e-commerce landing site for **Fresh Pantry**, a neighborhood grocery brand that celebrates unique, high-quality food products at great prices. The audience is health-conscious grocery shoppers who love discovering new finds — think the excitement of wandering a well-curated store aisle, translated to the web. The tone should feel **warm, playful, and modern** — approachable but polished, never corporate or sterile.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Think fresh greens, warm cream/off-white backgrounds, pops of sunny yellow or terracotta for accents. Avoid harsh neons or overly dark tones.
- **Typography:** A friendly rounded sans-serif for headings (something like Nunito or Poppins) paired with a clean body font. Keep it legible and inviting.
- **Imagery mood:** Bright, natural-light food photography vibes. Use placeholder images that suggest colorful produce, pantry staples, and cozy store interiors.
- **Layout:** Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, subtle shadows — the whole page should feel like a pleasant stroll through a sunlit market.

## Key Priorities

1. **The featured products carousel** is the centerpiece interaction — make sure the left/right navigation feels smooth and the product cards (with images, names, and prices) are visually appealing and easy to scan.
2. **The store locator** should feel functional and responsive: a zip code input with a search button that reveals mock store results. This drives the core business goal of in-store visits.
3. **Brand highlights stats** (500+ stores, 4,000+ products, etc.) should be presented as an eye-catching banner — use bold numbers with supporting labels to build credibility at a glance.
4. **Category hover effects** should feel delightful but not distracting — a gentle scale-up with an overlay is the target.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section list, all interaction specs, data display requirements, and navigation structure.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

## Brand

Fresh Pantry is your neighborhood grocery store reimagined — a place where quality meets affordability and every aisle holds a delicious surprise. Our mission is simple: make great food accessible to everyone, with a warm, welcoming shopping experience that feels like home.

## Brand

Fresh Pantry is your neighborhood grocery store reimagined — a place where quality meets affordability and every aisle holds a delicious surprise. We curate unique, hard-to-find food products alongside everyday essentials, all at prices that make you smile. Our mission is simple: make great food accessible to everyone, with a warm, welcoming shopping experience that feels like home.

Brand colors: #2D6A4F (primary forest green), #F4A261 (warm accent orange), #FEFAE0 (soft cream background)

## Hero Content

- About Us

  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --green: #2D6A4F;
      --green-light: #40916C;
      --green-pale: #D8F3DC;
      --orange: #F4A261;
      --orange-dark: #E76F51;
      --cream: #FEFAE0;
      --cream-dark: #F5EDD0;
      --text-dark: #1A3C2A;
      --text-mid: #4A6B5A;
      --text-light: #7A9B8A;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(45,106,79,0.08);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 20px rgba(45,106,79,0.12);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 40px rgba(45,106,79,0.16);
      --radius-sm: 12px;
      --radius-md: 20px;
      --radius-lg: 28px;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      background: var(--cream);
      color: var(--text-dark);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    h1, h2, h3, h4, h5 {
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    /* ── HEADER ── */
    header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(254,250,224,0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cream-dark);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .header-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 72px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      text-decoration: none;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
    }

    .logo-text {
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--green);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    nav a {
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    nav a:hover {
      background: var(--green-pale);
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .header-cta {
      background: var(--green) !important;
      color: var(--white) !important;
    }

    .header-cta:hover {
      background: var(--green-light) !important;
      color: var(--white) !important;
    }

    /* ── HERO ── */
    .hero {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green) 0%, var(--green-light) 60%, #52B788 100%);
      padding: 80px 24px 100px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.04'%3E%3Ccircle cx='30' cy='30' r='20'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-blobs {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-blob {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      opacity: 0.12;
    }

    .hero-blob-1 {
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      background: var(--orange);
      top: -150px; right: -100px;
    }

    .hero-blob-2 {
      width: 300px; height: 300px;
      background: var(--cream);
      bottom: -80px; left: 10%;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-content {}

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      color: var(--cream);
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .hero h1 span {
      color: var(--orange);
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      max-width: 480px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .hero-buttons {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--orange);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1rem;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(244,162,97,0.4);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--orange-dark);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(244,162,97,0.5);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .hero-visual {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .hero-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .hero-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); }

    .hero-card-img {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3rem;
    }

    .hero-card-img.produce { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #A7C957, #6A994E); }
    .hero-card-img.pantry { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E9C46A, #F4A261); }
    .hero-card-img.dairy { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ADE8F4, #48CAE4); }
    .hero-card-img.snacks { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFADAD, #FF6B6B); }

    .hero-card-body {
      padding: 12px 14px;
    }

    .hero-card-body p {
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--white);
      margin: 0;
    }

    .hero-card-body span {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;

      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;

      background: var(--green-pale);
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem);
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--text-light);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto;

      padding: 0 24px;

      margin-top: 8px;

  const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevBtn');
  const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextBtn');

  let currentIndex = 0;
  let visibleCount = 4;

  function getVisibleCount() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w <= 480) return 1;
    if (w <= 768) return 2;
    if (w <= 1100) return 3;
    return 4;
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    if (cards.length === 0) return 0;
    return cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width + 20;
  }

  const totalSlides = () => Math.ceil(cards.length / visibleCount);

  function buildDots() {
    dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    const n = totalSlides();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const dot = document.createElement('button');
      dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
      dot.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i));
      dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
    }
  }

  function updateDots() {
    const dots = dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
    dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === currentIndex));
  }

  function goTo(index) {
    visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
    const max = Math.max(0, cards.length - visibleCount);
    const cardStep = visibleCount;
    const rawOffset = index * cardStep;
    const safeOffset = Math.min(rawOffset, max);
    currentIndex = index;

    const cardW = getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${safeOffset * cardW}px)`;

    prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= totalSlides() - 1;
    updateDots();
  }

  function slideCarousel(dir) {
    const n = totalSlides();
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentIndex + dir, n - 1));
    goTo(next);
  }

  function initCarousel() {
    visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
    currentIndex = 0;
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
    buildDots();
    prevBtn.disabled = true;
    nextBtn.disabled = totalSlides() <= 1;
  }

  initCarousel();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => { initCarousel(); });

      return;
    }

<script>
  // ── CAROUSEL ──
  const track = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card');
  const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
  const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevBtn');
  const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextBtn');

  let currentIndex = 0;
  let visibleCount = 4;

  function getVisibleCount() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w <= 480) return 1;
    if (w <= 768) return 2;
    if (w <= 1100) return 3;
    return 4;
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    if (cards.length === 0) return 0;
    return cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width + 20;
  }

  const totalSlides = () => Math.ceil(cards.length / visibleCount);

  function buildDots() {
    dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    const n = totalSlides();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const dot = document.createElement('button');
      dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
      dot.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i));
      dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
    }
  }

  function updateDots() {
    const dots = dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
    dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === currentIndex));
  }

  function goTo(index) {
    visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
    const max = Math.max(0, cards.length - visibleCount);
    const cardStep = visibleCount;
    const rawOffset = index * cardStep;
    const safeOffset = Math.min(rawOffset, max);
    currentIndex = index;

    const cardW = getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${safeOffset * cardW}px)`;

    prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= totalSlides() - 1;
    updateDots();
  }

  function slideCarousel(dir) {
    const n = totalSlides();
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentIndex + dir, n - 1));
    goTo(next);
  }

  function initCarousel() {
    visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
    currentIndex = 0;
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
    buildDots();
    prevBtn.disabled = true;
    nextBtn.disabled = totalSlides() <= 1;
  }

  initCarousel();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => { initCarousel(); });

  // ── STORE LOCATOR ──
  function searchStores() {
    const zip = document.getElementById('zipInput').value.trim();
    if (!zip) {
      document.getElementById('zipInput').focus();
      return;
    }
    const results = document.getElementById('storeResults');
    results.classList.remove('visible');

    // Re-trigger animation
    const cards = results.querySelectorAll('.store-result-card');
    cards.forEach(c => { c.style.animation = 'none'; void c.offsetHeight; c.style.animation = ''; });

    setTimeout(() => { results.classList.add('visible'); }, 100);
  }

      return;
    }

    document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm').classList.add('visible');

  // ── CAROUSEL ──

  const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
  const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevBtn');
  const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextBtn');

  let currentIndex = 0;
  let visibleCount = 4;

  function getVisibleCount() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w <= 480) return 1;
    if (w <= 768) return 2;
    if (w <= 1100) return 3;
    return 4;
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    if (cards.length === 0) return 0;
    return cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width + 20;
  }

  const totalSlides = () => Math.ceil(cards.length / visibleCount);

  function buildDots() {
    dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    const n = totalSlides();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const dot = document.createElement('button');
      dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
      dot.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i));
      dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
    }
  }

  function updateDots() {
    const dots = dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
    dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === currentIndex));
  }

  function goTo(index) {
    visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
    const max = Math.max(0, cards.length - visibleCount);
    const cardStep = visibleCount;
    const rawOffset = index * cardStep;
    const safeOffset = Math.min(rawOffset, max);
    currentIndex = index;

    const cardW = getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${safeOffset * cardW}px)`;

    prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= totalSlides() - 1;
    updateDots();
  }

  function slideCarousel(dir) {
    const n = totalSlides();
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentIndex + dir, n - 1));
    goTo(next);
  }

  function initCarousel() {
    visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
    currentIndex = 0;
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
    buildDots();
    prevBtn.disabled = true;
    nextBtn.disabled = totalSlides() <= 1;
  }

  initCarousel();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => { initCarousel(); });

  // ── STORE LOCATOR ──
  function searchStores() {
    const zip = document.getElementById('zipInput').value.trim();
    if (!zip) {

    // Re-trigger animation
    const cards = results.querySelectorAll('.store-result-card');
    cards.forEach(c => { c.style.animation = 'none'; void c.offsetHeight; c.style.animation = ''; });

    setTimeout(() => { results.classList.add('visible'); }, 100);
  }

  // ── NEWSLETTER ──
  function subscribeNewsletter() {
    const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
    const emailRe = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!email || !emailRe.test(email)) {
      document.getElementById('emailInput').focus();
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById('newsletterForm').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm').classList.add('visible');
  }
</script>

  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card');
  const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
  const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevBtn');
  const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextBtn');

  let currentIndex = 0;
  let visibleCount = 4;

  function getVisibleCount() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w <= 480) return 1;
    if (w <= 768) return 2;
    if (w <= 1100) return 3;
    return 4;
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    if (cards.length === 0) return 0;
    return cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width + 20;
  }

  const totalSlides = () => Math.ceil(cards.length / visibleCount);

  function buildDots() {
    dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    const n = totalSlides();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const dot = document.createElement('button');
      dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
      dot.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i));
      dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
    }
  }

  function updateDots() {
    const dots = dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
    dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === currentIndex));
  }

  function goTo(index) {
    visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
    const max = Math.max(0, cards.length - visibleCount);
    const cardStep = visibleCount;
    const rawOffset = index * cardStep;
    const safeOffset = Math.min(rawOffset, max);
    currentIndex = index;

    const cardW = getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${safeOffset * cardW}px)`;

    prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= totalSlides() - 1;
    updateDots();
  }

  function slideCarousel(dir) {
    const n = totalSlides();
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentIndex + dir, n - 1));
    goTo(next);
  }

  function initCarousel() {
    visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
    currentIndex = 0;
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
    buildDots();
    prevBtn.disabled = true;
    nextBtn.disabled = totalSlides() <= 1;
  }

  initCarousel();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => { initCarousel(); });

  // ── STORE LOCATOR ──
  function searchStores() {
    const zip = document.getElementById('zipInput').value.trim();
    if (!zip) {
      document.getElementById('zipInput').focus();
      return;
    }
    const results = document.getElementById('storeResults');
    results.classList.remove('visible');

    // Re-trigger animation
    const cards = results.querySelectorAll('.store-result-card');
    cards.forEach(c => { c.style.animation = 'none'; void c.offsetHeight; c.style.animation = ''; });

    setTimeout(() => { results.classList.add('visible'); }, 100);
  }

  // ── NEWSLETTER ──
  function subscribeNewsletter() {
    const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
    const emailRe = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!email || !emailRe.test(email)) {
      document.getElementById('emailInput').focus();
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById('newsletterForm').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm').classList.add('visible');
  }
</script>

</body>
</html>
